prompts.telha: Create ONE production game sprite: a standalone Brazilian Morro house. Transparent background, no ground tile, no pedestal, no surrounding terrain, no cast ground shadow, no text. Reference 1 is mandatory geometry: keep same orthographic 2:1 isometric viewing angle, square 3x3 footprint, two equal visible walls, all verticals vertical, base edges slope exactly 1:2. Reference 2 is STYLE ONLY: clean hand drawn 2D navy contours, clear cel shaded warm light from upper left, architectural precision, rich but restrained detail, no watercolor or photorealism. Reference 3 is neighborhood mood only, do not reproduce the scene. Warm ivory plaster, complete terracotta gable roof with small dimensional clay tiles and correct ridge, petrol blue paneled door on LEFT visible face, blue grilled window on RIGHT visible face. Tiny clay planter next to door. No chimney. Door must read at gameplay size, approximately half wall height. House fills image with padding, entirely visible, single connected structure. No extra staircases or detached objects. Preserve guide proportions: compact single story walls, roof extends only a little beyond walls.
